headline: Paid Media | Acquisition Testing | Conversion Analytics
headline_rationale: The TENEX role prioritizes hands-on search/social execution, budget allocation, experimentation and measurement. The master supports Google/Microsoft/Meta campaigns, audience and bid experiments, GA4/GTM measurement and ROAS improvement. This headline omits unsupported cybersecurity, ABM, AdRoll and digital out-of-home expertise.
summary: Hands-on paid media marketer who connects campaign execution with measurement and budget decisions. Managed Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta and other channels, with experience ranging from 75+ client accounts to large in-house programs. Improved ROAS from 1.5 to 3.5 while increasing monthly marketing volume fourfold, and built automated reporting across more than ten channels. Brings practical conversion testing, GA4 and Google Tag Manager measurement, audience analysis and campaign automation.
factual_review: Read current v4 DOCX directly, including headline examples and evidence E002/E003/E006/E009/E015/E021/E038/E040/E075/E082/E120/E121. These support every summary claim. No B2B SaaS tenure, ABM ownership, cybersecurity domain expertise, AdRoll or OOH experience is claimed. Verified employment titles/dates and education remain unchanged.
